column1: # Fuzz inventory (TEST-006, TST-016, issue #16): one line per parser of the
# service, tab-separated: the parser, its package, the functions it consists
# of (comma-separated), the native fuzz target that covers them, and the
# issue that introduces a parser not built yet.
# named by the Test Strategy has a line; a built parser names a target that
# exists, with a committed seed corpus in <package>/testdata/fuzz/<target>;
# every parse-, decode-, unmarshal- or load-shaped function of a package the
# service is built from is listed under a target, so a new parser without a
# target fails the inventory. A planned line names no package, no functions
# and no target until its parser exists. scripts/fuzz.sh runs every target.
